 Wp(C)No.9501/2024 2
Zakhier Huzzain vs The Union Of India on 11 March, 2024
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118685786/
1

 Judgment
Dated this the 11th day of March, 2024 Petitioner has approached this Court seeking a direction to
the third respondent to carry out immediate valuation of the existing portion of the building in the
property of the petitioner, based on Exts.P2 to P4 requests

. 
2. Petitioner is aggrieved by the pendency of Ext.P4 request before the arbitrator, filed as per the provisions of Sections 28 and 94 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Petitioner submits that a portion of the land and the building situated therein was acquired and an award was passed in the proceedings by the Special Deputy Collector and Competent Authority, Land Acquisition National Highway, Alappuzha,
on 01.11.2021.
Petitioner further submits that a portion of the old building still subsists, which in a way causes interruption for the enjoyment of the property by the petitioner.

Petitioner submits that the arbitration proceedings are pending consideration before the arbitrator, the second respondent herein, in which Ext.P4 request has been made by the petitioner for assessing the old building.
Petitioner submits that though Ext.P4 request has been submitted, no action has been taken.

3. Heard the learned Government Pleader also.
4.

After hearing both sides, I am inclined to dispose of the Writ Petition with a direction to the second respondent to take up Ext.P4 requst and pass appropriate orders thereon, after affording an opportunity of being heard to the petitioner and other affected parties within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
Writ Petition is disposed of as above.
